messages:
maria: FYI AcmePayments opened a support ticket — their ingestion pipeline started failing after our midnight rollout. They say numeric fields are coming back as money-formatted strings and item arrays collapsed into an object.

maria: sample error from their parser: JSONDecodeError: Expecting '[' but got '{' at line 1

maria: they pasted a partial response that used to look like:

```\n{\n  \"order_id\": 12345,\n  \"amount_cents\": 1234,\n  \"items\": [{ \"sku\": \"X1\", \"qty\": 2 }]\n}\n```\n
maria: now they get: 

```\n{\n  \"order_id\": 12345,\n  \"amount_cents\": \"$12.34\",\n  \"items\": { \"sku\": \"X1\", \"qty\": 2 }\n}\n```\n
sam: thanks, can you paste the request they sent (headers + model param)?

maria: they called our hosted API with model: \"redwood-instruct-2025-v2\" and prompt that includes a schema instruction. header X-Redwood-Custom: acme-pay

deploy-bot: deploy log: rolled out model redwood-instruct-2025-v2 -> redwood-instruct-2025-v2.1 to prod/us-west-2 at 2025-11-03T04:12:08Z (canary->100%)

alex: assigning to eng-ml to investigate - this sounds like a formatter or output post-processing change in the new model variant.

raj: quick hypothesis: model's system prompt or safety wrapper started serializing cents as localized currency and collapsing single-item arrays into objects for brevity. Might be related to the structured-output renormalizer we landed last sprint.

sam: repro attempt on my laptop:
```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-2025-v2.1","input":"Generate order JSON matching schema: {order_id:int, amount_cents:int, items:array}"}'\n```

sam: response I got (dev region):
```\n{\n  \"order_id\": 98765,\n  \"amount_cents\": \"$9.87\",\n  \"items\": { \"sku\": \"A1\", \"qty\": 1 }\n}\n```\n
sam: repro confirmed locally against v2.1

olivia: can we confirm whether this is produced by the model text or by our structured-output post-processor? Check the raw token stream or model output before any schema wrapper runs.

raj: I pulled the raw tokens for my run; the model literally emitted a currency token and an object instead of an array. So it's model-side behavior.

raj: appears tied to the \"clarify-and-compact\" instruction we added to the instruction tuning for v2.1 — it tries to be more human-friendly and collapses singletons + formats numbers.

maria: acme asks for an ETA — their ingestion fails immediately in production when amount_cents is not an integer. They want a hotfix or workaround.

alex: immediate mitigations: 1) add parsing robustness on their side (accept string money format and coerce to cents), 2) rollback the model rollout to v2 temporarily OR 3) add server-side post-processor to coerce types back to schema.

olivia: I'll send a workaround patch to customer: parse both array and object for items and strip non-digits from amount_cents then multiply as needed. Provide a short code snippet.

maria: sent the workaround. customer test shows temporary success but they'd prefer we fix upstream.

raj: plan: revert the auto-100% canary -> set routing rule back to v2.0 for acme-pay account and pause further rollouts until we patch instruction tuning.

eng-oncall: pinging infra to create a targeted routing override for tenant acme-pay and any other tenants that have strict typed ingestion (matching known list).

alex: file a regression ticket, tag eng-ml, eng-runtime, and product. Set priority P1 for customers with strict schema ingestion.

maria: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2048 — added logs, sample responses, and customer repro steps.

sam: follow-up items for eng-ml: revert instruction tweak that causes human-formatting, add unit tests to assert numeric fields remain numeric in structured-output mode, and add a heuristic to always emit arrays for schema array types even when single element.

raj: I'll prepare a small model patch and run canary on staging + run the evaluation suite with strict JSON schema checks.

maria: customer confirmed rollback helped. Their ingestion resumed. They're waiting for the permanent fix and a postmortem.

maria: marking thread as escalated -> leaving notes for postmortem and customer communications. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall: closing routing override once fix is in prod.
